items.what: Google is winding Jules down: you can keep working in sessions until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules is read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026.
items.test: Before Nov 11, export any sessions you need with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules) and move open tasks to another coding agent.

deadlines.label: last day to continue sessions (read-only after)

items.what: Since Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default and your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them; existing databases are not affected.
items.test: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app; if you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions.

items.what: From Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions: plans and token allowances stay the same, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it.
items.source_name: Bolt release notes, Oct 12 - 18: Billing through Link starts November 1
items.test: Check your next Bolt invoice for tax; if checkout offers your local currency, note the charge can vary month to month with the exchange rate, and USD stays available for a fixed price.

items.what: Lovable's docs say the current chat pricing (per-message price and daily chat allowance) is a temporary offering that applies through Oct 31, 2026; the page does not say what applies after.
items.test: Recheck the Lovable chat docs and your plan's chat allowance on Nov 2 before budgeting chat-heavy work.

deadlines.label: current chat pricing applies through this date

items.what: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back.
items.test: Find scripts and settings that use fast mode with Opus 4.8 and switch them to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup before Nov 30.
